class.name: LuaTextureNode
class.brief_description: A Lua script drawing a texture.
class.description: While it is in the tree it owns a [DrawingServer] drawing shown by [member texture], and hands it to its script as the first argument of the file ([code]local drawing = ...[/code]). The script runs in the editor as well; [code]reloaded.time[/code] animates it there, as the simulation's clock does not run in the editor. A material in the scene names the same [DrawingTexture] and shows what the script draws. With a [member material] the drawing is drawn through it into the texture - a [code]canvas_item[/code] shader that gives the picture a look of its kind (a LED matrix, a screen's glow) at the texture's size, while the script draws at [member drawing_size].

members.member: The size [lb]px[rb] the script draws at when [member material] draws it into the texture; without a material the texture's size is used.
A [code]canvas_item[/code] shader material the drawing is drawn through into [member texture]; none for the drawing as it is.
The texture the script's drawing is shown by; its size and transparency are the drawing's.
